defect: legalize_repair_axis iterated from zero through repair_max inclusive and performed a flip after every infeasible probe. A zero budget executed one flip; the configured sixteen-flip limit could execute seventeen before reporting exhaustion.
correction: After checking feasibility and true terminal infeasibility, reject an exhausted flip budget before selecting or executing another flip. Keep one final feasibility probe after the last allowed flip. choice_counts and flips now describe only executed work. No policy limit raised.

negative_control.failure: floorplan contracts: zero repair budget executed a flip

cases: Zero budget on an infeasible but repairable axis leaves separation states, flips and executed-choice accounting untouched.
Two independent cycles across budgets zero through three require exactly two flips; exhaustion does not publish positions or false terminal infeasibility evidence.
An already feasible axis still passes with a zero repair budget.
Seventeen independent cycles exhaust at exactly sixteen flips under the production policy value; a seventeen-flip budget solves them.

incumbent_screens.scope: One prepared-input construction per board, no full audit, DRC or renders. Exact prior accepted PCB hashes; placement contract and flow checks pass with zero hard-red terms. Times include observer overhead and uncontrolled OS cache, not a speed comparison.

limitations: This corrects bounded-work semantics, a prerequisite for controlled coupled-axis exploration. It does not yet implement coupled-axis backtracking, qualify a smaller carrier, or complete the sustained goal.
